title: How many runs are already sorted?
hook: An unsorted sequence may already contain useful order.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Detect ascending runs and merge runs rather than treating every element as a singleton.

misconception: A merge sort must split an already sorted run apart.
objective: Detect ascending runs and merge runs rather than treating every element as a singleton.

claims.text: The trace discovers already ordered pieces before merging them. Existing order changes the number of runs, so adaptive merging does not need to pretend that every item starts alone.
